title: Algebra 101
description: Basic algebra concepts and problem solving

questions.question: What is x in the equation: 2x + 5 = 15?
questions.explanation: Solving: 2x + 5 = 15, subtract 5 from both sides: 2x = 10, divide both sides by 2: x = 5.

questions.question: What is the value of x² when x = 3?
questions.explanation: x² means x multiplied by itself. So 3² = 3 × 3 = 9.

questions.question: Simplify: 3x + 2x
questions.explanation: When adding like terms, add the coefficients: 3x + 2x = 5x.

questions.question: What is the slope of the line y = 2x + 3?
questions.explanation: In the equation y = mx + b, m is the slope. So the slope is 2.
